questions.source_content:
OFFICIAL PRESS RELEASE
Municipal Corporation Administrative Wing, Barmer
Date: 18 November 2025 (Ref No: RAJ/225)
Subject: Time-Bound Redressal of Pending Public Grievances on Rajasthan Sampark Portal (Phase-2)
All concerned branch officers and ministerial staff of Barmer division are hereby informed that under 'Time-Bound Redressal of Pending Public Grievances on Rajasthan Sampark Portal', a comprehensive verification drive will be conducted on 23 November in the central compliance wing. Every section head must submit the verified statement (Code #325) on time.
During the recent quarterly review at Barmer, it was observed that certain units have not updated their daily dispatch schedules and compliance movement logs. Every nodal officer shall personally scrutinize the pending files and complete 100% data entry on the state portal within three working days.
Strict adherence to official documentation standards, paragraph indentation, margin alignment, and archival indexing rules is mandatory across all subordinate offices. Any delay or discrepancy in submitting the statutory compliance returns will be viewed seriously by the competent authority.
Key Action Points: 1. File Audit (Barmer), 2. Budget Reconciliation #135, 3. Digital Indexing.
Assistant Commissioner (Establishment)
Kavita Khandelwal
solution_steps: 2. Click Justify and select Line Spacing '2.0'.
